itinerary.title: Island Arrival & Sunset Cocktails
itinerary.desc: Direct flight arrival at Caticlan Airport (MPH). Meet and greet by private coordinator. VIP speedboat transfer directly to Boracay Island. Check in at beachfront resort, enjoy welcome chilled coconut drink, and unwind with a sunset stroll along Station 1.

itinerary.title: Island Hopping & Paraw Sunset Sail
itinerary.desc: Morning island hopping boat tour visiting Puka Shell Beach and Crocodile Island coral reef. Snorkeling with marine turtles. Seafood barbecue picnic lunch. Afternoon crystal kayak session followed by private Paraw sunset sailing.

itinerary.title: Morning Paddleboarding & Departure
itinerary.desc: Hearty buffet breakfast at resort. Stand-up paddleboarding session or D'Mall souvenir shopping for dried mangoes and calamansi muffins. Check-out and private speedboat transfer back to Caticlan Airport for flight home.

itinerary.title: Touchdown in Paradise & Hot Springs
itinerary.desc: Morning flight touchdown at Busuanga Airport (USU). Scenic 35-minute van transfer through pasture lands to Coron town. Check-in and relax. Late afternoon trip to Mount Tapyas 724-step panoramic summit, followed by a warm soak in Maquinit Natural Saltwater Hot Springs.

itinerary.title: Coron Ultimate Island Hopping Expedition
itinerary.desc: Board motorized outrigger banca for the world-renowned Coron Island circuit. Hike the wooden steps to view Kayangan Lake, swim beneath the limestone archway of Twin Lagoon, snorkel over the sunken Skeleton Wreck, and feast on a freshly grilled seafood lunch.

itinerary.title: Secluded Island Escapade
itinerary.desc: Cruise to the outer Calamian islands: powdery Malcapuya Island, Banana Island, and the shallow turquoise sandbar of Bulog Dos. Relax on hammocks and enjoy peaceful tropical isolation. Free evening to dine at Coron Harbor.

itinerary.title: Cashew Factory & Return Flight
itinerary.desc: Breakfast by the bayside pool. Quick visit to Coron Harvest for roasted garlic cashews and souvenirs. Airport shuttle to Busuanga Airport for your scenic flight back to Manila.

itinerary.title: Ascent to the City of Pines
itinerary.desc: Morning departure from Manila aboard Victory Liner Deluxe Bus with onboard restroom and WiFi. Scenic mountain ascent via Aspiras-Palispis Highway. Check-in at Camp John Hay. Stroll through the Bell Amphitheater and enjoy hearty dinner at Session Road.

itinerary.title: Banaue UNESCO Terraces & Ifugao Village
itinerary.desc: Early scenic drive through the Cordillera mountain ridges toward Banaue. Marvel at the 2,000-year-old carved emerald stairways to heaven. Meet traditional weavers and woodcarvers. Afternoon return with photo stop at La Trinidad Strawberry Valley.

itinerary.title: Baguio Market Shopping & Departure
itinerary.desc: Highland breakfast with fresh strawberries and mountain coffee. Visit Baguio Public Market and Good Shepherd Convent for authentic ube jam, peanut brittle, and hand-woven blankets. Board late afternoon luxury coach back to Manila.

itinerary.title: Welcome to the Surfing Capital
itinerary.desc: Touch down at Sayak Airport (IAO). Enjoy the iconic drive bordered by thousands of coconut palms into General Luna. Check in at your tropical eco-villa. Catch the golden hour at Cloud 9 wooden pier and sample authentic woodfired pizza.

itinerary.title: Tri-Island Hopping & Surfing Lesson
itinerary.desc: Morning banca boat tour hopping between Naked Island's pure white sandbar, Daku Island for a fresh grilled seafood boodle fight under palm trees, and Guyam Island. Afternoon 1-on-1 surf coaching on gentle beginner waves.

itinerary.title: Sugba Lagoon & Magpupungko Pools
itinerary.desc: Cruise through lush mangrove canals to Sugba Lagoon. Leap off the famous wooden diving board and paddleboard across serene emerald waters. Continue to Magpupungko Rock Pools during low tide for natural cliff swimming.

itinerary.title: Island Cafe Hopping & Departure
itinerary.desc: Morning acai bowls along Tourism Road. Pick up handmade coconut crafts and local surf merchandise. Private van shuttle back to Sayak Airport for your flight back to Manila.

itinerary.title: Ferry Crossing & Paliton Sunset
itinerary.desc: Fly into Dumaguete (DGT) and board the 45-minute OceanJet fast craft to Siquijor Island. Check-in at Coco Grove Beach Resort along San Juan coastline. Relax under leaning coconut palms at Paliton Beach as the sun sets over the Visayan Sea.

itinerary.title: Cambugahay Falls & Heritage Circuit
itinerary.desc: Cool off at the 3-tiered cascading turquoise waters of Cambugahay Falls with thrilling Tarzan rope swings. Visit the 400-year-old mystical Balete Tree for a natural fish spa, and head to Salagdoong Beach for scenic cliff leaps.

itinerary.title: Marine Sanctuary Snorkel & Return
itinerary.desc: Morning snorkel right outside your resort at Tubod Marine Sanctuary among giant clams and vibrant coral fish. Check-out, fast ferry back to Dumaguete, and afternoon flight back to Manila.

itinerary.title: Cebu Heritage & Lechon Welcome
itinerary.desc: Arrive at Mactan-Cebu International Airport (CEB). Check-in and enjoy authentic Cebu lechon for lunch. Tour Magellan's Cross, Basilica del Santo Niño, and scenic Temple of Leah. Rest early for south tour.

itinerary.title: Whale Shark Encounter & Ferry to Bohol
itinerary.desc: Early morning drive to Oslob for an ethical snorkeling encounter with gentle whale sharks. Marvel at the sheer beauty of Tumalog Falls. Return to Cebu port and take the 2-hour fast ferry to Tagbilaran, Bohol. Check-in at Panglao beachfront resort.

itinerary.title: Bohol Countryside & Chocolate Hills
itinerary.desc: Ascend to the viewing terrace overlooking the iconic Chocolate Hills. See the world's smallest primates at the Philippine Tarsier Sanctuary. Board a covered riverboat on Loboc River for a traditional Filipino buffet lunch and cultural folk dancing.

itinerary.title: Panglao Beach Morning & Departure
itinerary.desc: Morning beach swim on Panglao's famous white sands. Pick up Bohol peanut kisses. Fast ferry back to Cebu City and transfer to Mactan Airport for your flight home.
